entries.text: There’s only one thing left on the agenda.\c\nYou must defeat the big boss...and have Team\nStar disband for good![VAR 0x0114(0009)]

entries.text: Don’t worry—there’s no need to search them out.\nThe true identity of the big boss...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0110_cassiopeia_12

entries.text: is none other than me.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0110_cassiopeia_13

entries.text: I didn’t mean to keep it from you for so long, but\nthe right moment never came.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0110_cassiopeia_15

entries.text: I’m the one who formed Team Star. Back then, the\nmembers of the team were my closest friends...\r\nand I treasured them more than anything.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0110_cassiopeia_16

entries.text: If they go on like this, Team Star won’t do any\ngood for anyone.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0110_cassiopeia_17

entries.text: They’ve got to give it up. So I’m using the code\nwe made together to force them to disband.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
